svg.metadata: {"id": "s103", "name": "银杏校园", "cat": "季节专题", "tags": ["校园", "秋天", "消防", "安全"], "desc": "秋日校园：教学楼前两排金黄银杏、满地黄叶铺成的金色地毯、国旗、红色消防栓和消防器材箱，适合开场与校园防火。", "stand": {"ground_y": 860, "x": [540, 1380]}, "subtitle": [0, 950, 1920, 1060], "layers": [{"name": "sky", "enter": "fade", "delay": 0, "loop": null, "depth": 0}, {"name": "clouds", "enter": "slide-l", "delay": 0.1, "loop": "drift", "depth": 0.05}, {"name": "building", "enter": "rise", "delay": 0.25, "loop": null, "depth": 0.3}, {"name": "flagpole", "enter": "grow", "delay": 0.4, "loop": null, "depth": 0.35}, {"name": "flag", "enter": "fade", "delay": 0.9, "loop": "sway", "depth": 0.35}, {"name": "ground", "enter": "rise", "delay": 0.35, "loop": null, "depth": 0.6}, {"name": "ginkgo", "enter": "grow", "delay": 0.5, "loop": null, "depth": 0.65}, {"name": "fire_gear", "enter": "pop", "delay": 0.8, "loop": null, "depth": 0.7}, {"name": "near", "enter": "rise", "delay": 1.0, "loop": null, "depth": 1}, {"name": "falling", "enter": "fade", "delay": 1.1, "loop": "fall", "depth": 0.9}], "palette": {"sky1": "#8DCBF0", "sky2": "#E8F5FF", "bld": "#F4E9DC", "bld2": "#E2D0BC", "bld3": "#C9B39B", "win": "#9CCBE6", "win2": "#D5EDFA", "roofb": "#C7553D", "ground": "#E9D6B4", "ground2": "#D9C09A", "mat": "#F7C844", "t1": "#F6B930", "t2": "#FFD95A", "t3": "#E07A22", "t4": "#D9542B", "trunk": "#7A4E33", "trunk2": "#5E3A26", "pole": "#C9CED6", "flag": "#E2382F", "star": "#FFD84A", "cab": "#E2382F", "cab2": "#B9271F", "glass": "#DFF1FA", "ext": "#D42C24", "hyd": "#E2382F", "hyd2": "#B9271F"}}
